name: Mist Orb (waves drop)
notes: A drop of the waves mode: the classic run's Mist Orb (a purple orb with a misty swirl), with the same look and the same boost. A wave monster that faints has a 25% chance to drop one of the 5 items, picked at random (item 3 of drop_kind; at most 3 Mist Orbs per run, see enm_wave_1). It appears at the monster's feet, or, when the monster fainted in the dark edge the player can't walk into, on the nearest spot of lit floor (free_spot). Only the player can pick it up (monsters walk over it): walking into it plays the item chime, floats '+10% DODGE' over the player and wild monsters' moves lose 10 points of accuracy against the player for the rest of the run (boost_dodge: a 95% move hits 85% of the time); ground zones still never miss. It adds to the same variable as the Mist Orb level-up card, so the two boosts add up. It stays on the floor until it is picked up or the run ends.
